Vanessa / team — reviewed the SOW redlines and the commercial asks. High-level assessment:

1) MFN (12 mo) — HIGH RISK. Key concerns:
   - If MFN references list price or unit price without carve-outs, we could be obligated to retroactively rebate higher-volume or promotional pricing to Optima across other customers.
   - Need to clearly define the comparator set (e.g., identical contract scope / region / vertical).

2) Exclusivity (6 mo) — HIGH RISK AND OPERATIONAL COST:
   - Exclusive placement in marketplace or an engineering-only exclusivity could block sales motions for other partners and create precedent.
   - If enforced broadly, may limit channel opportunities; we would require a narrow, productized definition: exclusivity for a specific feature in a specific vertical and limited to co-marketing placement only (not product-level blocking).

3) 25% discount — Finance will confirm but structurally acceptable if term/commits are sufficient.

Recommended mitigations:
- Convert MFN to a capped best-price commitment with clear comparator definition and a default carve-out for public promotions/marketplace discounts.
- Convert exclusivity to a 6-month "launch window" for co-marketing + preferred placement (no technical blocking).
- Add sunset clauses and renewal review.

If the customer insists on a pure MFN + hard exclusivity, this must be elevated to execs for approval (commercial + legal + finance). Attaching a quick pricing workup for your reference (pricing_workup_optima.xlsx).

Jonas Weber
Deal Desk / Legal Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_workup_optima.xlsx

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-22T08:09:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Quick confirm — pricing, MFN & integration exclusivity

Vanessa / Jonas — quick finance read:

- The 25% first-year discount across a 24-month term is borderline but acceptable from a unit economics perspective if we secure minimum committed usage / MRR guarantees and a 24-month prepay or early-termination fee. Approve conditionally.

- MFN (unqualified) is a no from finance. Exposure could be material: if we later offer a lower price to a large partner or run a time-limited promotion, MFN triggers retroactive obligations. We can consider a capped-Best-Price (BP) with a cap at X% lower than quoted and explicit carve-outs (marketplace, promotions, volume-based discounts beyond a threshold).

- Exclusivity must be narrowed. A marketing/preference window is acceptable; technical exclusivity or product-level blocking is not.

Given the combination of MFN + exclusivity, this is above Deal Desk signoff threshold. Need executive approval for any MFN or exclusivity commitment. Please escalate with a concise decision request:
  Option A: Accept modified terms (capped-BP + co-marketing exclusivity + 25% discount with commitment)
  Option B: Decline MFN & exclusivity, offer 25% discount + preferred placement + joint PR, or
  Option C: Walk (if customer insists on hard MFN + hard exclusivity).

I'll back Option A if execs accept the caps and carve-outs; otherwise prefer Option B.

Rishi Malhotra
Director, FP&A
Redwood Inference

Subject: EXEC APPROVAL REQUEST — OptimaHealth (RDW-2026-0417): MFN + exclusivity escalation

Markus / Laura — escalating for a short exec decision. Optima (strategic healthcare ISV) is requesting three interlinked commercial items:

  1) 25% first-year discount on a 24-month committed term (Finance conditionally okay).
  2) MFN for 12 months (customer wording: broad; Deal Desk/Finance view: unqualified MFN is high risk).
  3) 6-month exclusivity for the integration in their specialty clinics (customer requests hard exclusivity).

Summary of internal recommendations:
- Legal/Deal Desk (Jonas): Convert MFN -> capped Best-Price with explicit carve-outs; convert exclusivity -> co-marketing/preferred placement only.
- Finance (Rishi): Approve 25% discount if committed MRR or prepayment/ETFs are in place; MFN as-is is not acceptable.

Decision requested: please reply with one of the options below by EOD PST today so we can respond to Optima (they've asked for a yes/no within 48 hours):

Option A (Preferred): Approve modified package: capped-BP (cap = no more than 5% below quoted price), carved-out promotions, exclusivity limited to a 6-month launch window for co-marketing and preferred marketplace placement (no product-level blocking). Approve 25% discount conditional on a 24-month commit and a minimum annual revenue threshold + 6-month prepaid credit or ET fee.

Option B (Compromise): Decline MFN and hard exclusivity; offer 25% discount + preferred placement + joint launch PR.

Option C (Walk): If Optima insists on broad MFN + hard exclusivity, we walk.

If you approve Option A, Jonas and Legal will draft the capped-BP language and the specific carve-outs; Rishi will finalize pricing mechanics.

Thanks — this is time-sensitive, happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
